en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a wooden railway station building labeled "Mark Station." The one-story structure has a gabled roof, chimney, and decorative trim, set among forested surroundings. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand on and near the station platform. Printed text appears at the bottom, along with handwritten Swedish greetings.
